protocol.training: Earlier complete postseason seasons only; outcome labels never enter the current game input.
protocol.workload_ratio: Fit prior-season matched pitcher regular/postseason exposure ratios. Never multiply current-game market-anchored exposure by a history-proxy ratio.
protocol.calibration: Regularized intercept and slope fitted only to earlier-season ML predictions and outcomes; minimum 60 games.

selection_policy.price_basis: one declared book and snapshot; no hindsight best-price shopping

verification_requires: Authentic pregame entry prices, identified book, market and timestamp
Correct settlement with integer push and void accounting
At least 100 selected wagers across at least three postseasons
Positive 95% series-cluster bootstrap lower bound for realized ROI
Positive paired probability-score improvement versus market
No unresolved temporal, identity or settlement violations
Confirmation on forecasts frozen before future games
protocol.historical_close_only: A closing-only archive permits a labeled hypothetical close-price replay; it cannot verify executable entry ROI or CLV.
reporting: All eligible rows and blocked coverage
K MAE, RMSE, bias and distribution scores
ML Brier, log loss, calibration and market comparison
protocol.promotion: Keep research status whenever any verification requirement is missing or fails. A successful software test is not a betting-edge test.

fixed_parameters.usage_fit: median matched pitcher-season POST outs / late REG mean outs; last 45 regular-season days; minimum 3 REG starts; equal pitcher-season weighting
fixed_parameters.calibration: ridge logistic intercept+slope prior(0,1), lambda1, min60 earlier-year games

limitations: 2015–2025 was already consumed in prior mechanism research; this is development evidence.
Historical workload is reconstructed from regular-season logs, rather than captured current-game supporting markets.
Historical starting lineups come from completed boxscore identities, rather than timestamped pregame captures.
Season-end public skill and park data is reconstructed; release has no original timestamped feature receipts.
No accepted historical K line/price pairs or executable moneyline entry snapshots; profitability and CLV remain unmeasured.
No multiple-comparison promotion: all fixed challengers and cohorts are reported.
